independent_optimized_comparison.method: Prepared-range, arbitrary-nonce and strict-target APIs compared in isolated local shared-library builds.
independent_optimized_comparison.cases: Three distinct jobs, zero/nonzero/all-ones namespaces, first 0/63/UINT64_MAX-63, arbitrary nonces, targets zero/max/exact digest/digest+1
independent_optimized_comparison.follow_up: Only comments changed after the comparison: the requirement description was corrected, and worker modification/endian comments were added. No arithmetic changed; rebuilding retained the same portable worker SHA-256.

isa_inspection.scope: Read-only objdump inspection of the exact local x86-64 worker. Baseline x86-64 instructions, including SSE2, are allowed.

checks: Baseline ISA audit: no unexpected VEX/EVEX, AVX, PCLMUL, GFNI, BMI/BMI2 or SSSE3
cpu_probe.selection_policy: Ordered supported and installed backends; not a performance guarantee. The public AVX512 backend conservatively requires AVX2 and PCLMUL in addition to AVX512F/BW and GFNI.

launcher.process_cleanup: Real owned descendants including a second process group stopped; unrelated sentinel preserved; no next phase after SIGTERM during cleanup.

cases: exact authorized fee recipient, endpoint, worker, and schedule
absolute boundaries, forward time jumps, backwards-clock rejection, skipped windows, and launch reset

fee_validation.accounting: 97 minutes user and up to 3 minutes fee per 100 minutes of monotonic scheduled runtime; connection and cleanup time are inside slots.
fee_validation.shutdown: Fee cleanup begins up to 4 seconds before the absolute slot end; graceful waiting is capped by that end. OS scheduling, in-flight work, and termination latency prevent an exact executed-hash or process-lifetime bound.
